text: The similarity between the manifest and the primary, and the difference of the Purusha, have been explained in the Prakṛti-āryā, starting from "the one who does not discriminate the three gunas." In that, what was mentioned as the "three gunas," the manifest and the unmanifest—to establish the nature of those gunas (i.e., "what are those gunas?"), this is now stated.
